content.rendered:
Electronics Waste Recycling or high-volume E-scrap processing and sorting need the right tool for the job. That tool is the AUTOSORT Fines Optical Sorter!

The TOMRA AUTOSORT Fines machine is the machine of choice for electronics waste recycling or E-scrap processing. It is so precise it can accurately find and sort precious metal e-waste pieces in the 1-2 mm range. It acts as a “Swiss Army Knife” to produce a clean metals fraction, clean green circuit boards, upgrade your plastics fraction, and clean up your aluminum and other precious metals. It utilizes 4 different technologies combined in one unit to improve your electronics recycling end products, whatever they are. The 4 sensors are:

  • Ultra-High Resolution near infrared spectrometer
  • Camera detection
  • High resolution metal sensors
  • Deep LAIser object detection with AI (artificial intelligence)

Functions of the AUTOSORT Fines machine for e-waste processing:

  • Produces a clean mixed metals fraction with minimal plastics at high capacity (Finder mode)
  • Captures clean circuit boards (+ some wire)
  • 4 sizes available (1000, 1400, 2000, 2800) for different throughput requirements
  • Cleans up aluminum fraction
  • If situation allows: makes copper or stainless-steel concentrates
  • Plastic sorting: ABS, PS, PC_ABS recovery including recognizing black plastics

Our Norwalk, CT Test Center is equipped with an AUTOSORT Fines optical sorter so you can test your own e-scrap material and see what separation is possible. Schedule your test today!
